purpose: Usage scene — living room coffee table context showing the AI companion device naturally integrated into a bright, warm minimalist living space
prompt:
EDIT INSTRUCTION:
- Preserve from reference 1 (hero-product): the exact organic pebble-shaped device form — warm ceramic white matte body (#F2EDE8), horizontal elliptical screen in upper 1/3, soft amber (#E8C9A0) breathing light ring around screen, woven fabric mesh (#C8C3BC) on lower half, soft-stone gray (#D4CFC9) silicone base. Keep the same proportions (height-to-width ~1:1.3), same continuous curves, no sharp edges.
- ADD: Place the device on a light wood coffee table in a bright minimalist living room. Around it: a ceramic teapot and cup, a small potted green plant, a book, a soft linen throw on a nearby sofa. Bright warm natural window light from the left. Scandinavian/Japanese minimal interior — light wood, white walls, natural textures.
- COMPOSITION: Device positioned at center-left of frame, eye-level or slightly elevated view. Living room environment visible — sofa edge, plants, warm natural light. The device feels like a natural part of the living space, like a decorative object.
- PALETTE: warm-shell #F2EDE8 (device), gentle-amber #E8C9A0 (breathing light), light oak wood, soft greens from plant, matte-cloud #E8E4DF (walls/ambient).
- DO NOT: make the device look medical; add cold lighting; change the product form; add glossy surfaces.
